question.text: The number of isoelectronic species among $\mathrm{Sc}^{3+}, \mathrm{Cr}^{2+}, \mathrm{Mn}^{3+}, \mathrm{Co}^{3+}$ and $\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}$ is ' $\mathrm{n}^{\prime}$. If ' $\mathrm{n}^{\prime}$ moles of AgCl is formed during the reaction of complex with formula $\mathrm{CoCl}_{3}(\mathrm{en})_{2} \mathrm{NH}_{3}$ with excess of $\mathrm{AgNO}_{3}$ solution, then the number of electrons present in the $t_{2 g}$ orbital of the complex is $\_\_\_\_$.
